aggregation_rules.U1-MG01-IC04: Synthesize the two intercept responses into ONE source-level IC04 evidence judgment for Quick Check 01. evidence_strength_guardrails.CONVINCING: Substantially demonstrates the intended target; a minor execution slip may remain when understanding is still clear.
evidence_strength_guardrails.PARTIAL: Meaningful correct target reasoning is visible, but an important part is incomplete/inconsistent or one significant error undermines a complete demonstration.
evidence_strength_guardrails.LIMITED: Some target-relevant work is present, but a major misconception/error means little valid demonstration of the intended target.
evidence_strength_guardrails.UNUSABLE: Blank, irrelevant, unreadable, or otherwise insufficient for a defensible target judgment.

version_rule: All parallel versions preserve these evidence roles. Determine the clean task first, then map the response. Do not infer the I Can from handwriting alone.
